e.title: StatsForecast
e.summary: 高速统计时序预测库（Nixtla，4.9k★）：ETS/ARIMA/Theta——理赔/费用趋势预测
e.body: StatsForecast（Nixtla，GitHub 4.9k★+）是高速统计时序预测库：ETS、ARIMA、Theta、MSTL 等经典模型的大规模快速实现（M5 竞赛级性能）。对 RIAA：理赔/费用趋势的统计预测——准备金/预算场景的月度季度预测（同 [[prophet]] 的预测谱系）；速度优势（大规模保单/险种批量预测）；与 [[pymc]]（贝叶斯时序）对照频率派/贝叶斯派；配 [[aggregate-python]]（聚合模拟）可做「预测 → 模拟」的完整现金流场景。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 确认（4.9k★，统计时序预测库），未实测
e.summary_en: Fast statistical time-series forecasting (Nixtla, 4.9k stars): ETS/ARIMA/Theta — claims/expense trend forecasting
e.summary_hk: 高速統計時序預測庫（Nixtla，4.9k★）：ETS/ARIMA/Theta——理賠/費用趨勢預測
e.body_en: StatsForecast (Nixtla, 4.9k+ GitHub stars) is a lightning-fast statistical forecasting library: large-scale, efficient implementations of classic models — ETS, ARIMA, Theta, MSTL (M5-competition-grade performance). For RIAA: statistical forecasting of claims/expense trends — monthly/quarterly projections for reserving and budgeting (the forecasting lineage of [[prophet]]); the speed advantage suits large-scale batch forecasting across portfolios/lines; compare frequentist vs Bayesian with [[pymc]] (Bayesian time series); with [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate simulation) it builds complete cashflow scenarios from forecast → simulation.
e.body_hk: StatsForecast（Nixtla，GitHub 4.9k★+）是高速統計時序預測庫：ETS、ARIMA、Theta、MSTL 等經典模型的大規模快速實現（M5 競賽級性能）。對 RIAA：理賠/費用趨勢的統計預測——準備金/預算場景的月度季度預測（同 [[prophet]] 的預測譜系）；速度優勢（大規模保單/險種批量預測）；與 [[pymc]]（貝葉斯時序）對照頻率派/貝葉斯派；配 [[aggregate-python]]（聚合模擬）可做「預測 → 模擬」的完整現金流場景。
